text.A: **본 방침은 귀하가 어디에 있든 적용됩니다.** 당사는 영국 개인정보 보호법을 준수하며, 귀하가 거주하는 국가의 개인정보 보호법도 적용되는 경우에는 그 법률도 준수합니다.
text.B: **알레르기 및 식단 관련 메모.** 당사는 이를 주문과 함께 푸드트럭에 전달하며, 그 밖의 어떠한 목적으로도 이용하지 않습니다. 당사는 주문일로부터 12개월이 지나면 이를 귀하의 이름 및 연락처와 함께 삭제합니다(제7조 참조).
text.C: **국외 이전.** 귀하의 계정 정보와 주문 정보는 영국에서 저장되고 처리됩니다. 일부 업무는 영국 외에서 처리됩니다. 메뉴 추출과 WhatsApp 자동 응답은 미국에 있는 Google 서비스를 이용하고, WhatsApp 메시지 전달은 미국의 Meta가, 결제는 미국의 Stripe가 처리하며, 푸시 알림은 미국의 Apple과 Google이 전달합니다. 정보가 영국 밖으로 이전되는 경우, 그 이전은 영국 적정성 규정(UK adequacy regulations) 또는 국제 데이터 이전 계약(International Data Transfer Agreement)이나 부속서(Addendum)의 적용을 받으며, 귀하 국가의 법률이 요구하는 경우에는 해당 법률이 인정하는 보호조치의 적용도 받습니다. 귀하는 적용되는 보호조치의 세부 내용을 당사에 요청할 수 있습니다.
text.G:
당사의 [이용약관](/terms)은 HatchGrab이 이용되는 모든 국가에 적용됩니다. 일부 국가에는 추가 규정이 있습니다. 이 페이지는 그러한 규정을 국가별로 정합니다.

아래의 항목이 귀하에게 적용되는 경우, 해당 항목은 당사 이용약관의 일부를 구성합니다. 해당 항목의 내용이 이용약관과 다른 경우, 해당 국가에 대해서는 이 페이지가 적용됩니다.

귀하의 국가가 목록에 없는 경우 추가 규정은 없으며, 이용약관이 기재된 그대로 적용됩니다. 당사의 [개인정보 처리방침](/privacy)은 모든 국가에서 동일합니다.

back.A: **This policy applies wherever you are.** We comply with UK personal data protection law, and where the personal data protection law of the country you live in also applies, we comply with that law too.
back.B: **Allergy and diet-related notes.** We pass them to the food truck together with the order and do not use them for any other purpose. We delete them, together with your name and contact details, once 12 months have passed from the order date (see section 7).
back.C: Where information is transferred outside the UK, the transfer is subject to the UK adequacy regulations or the International Data Transfer Agreement or Addendum, and, where the law of your country requires it, it is also subject to a safeguard recognised by that law.
back.D: ## 8. Your rights / Under UK personal data protection law and, where applicable, the law of the country you live in, you have the following rights. [7 bullets unchanged] / The law of the country you live in may grant these rights under different names or grant additional rights. You have those rights too. / **How to make a request.** Please send an email to privacy@hatchgrab.com. We check that the request is genuine before acting on it. You can have another person make the request on your behalf, and we will not discriminate against you because you made a request. We reply within one month or, where the law of your country requires it, sooner. If you ordered from a food truck, we may pass your request to that food truck, because that food truck decides how your order information is used. If we refuse a request, you can ask for reconsideration by replying to our answer. / **Account deletion.** [old text unchanged] When an operator's account is deleted, we also delete the names, contact details and notes of that operator's customers from the orders we keep. / **Marketing emails.** We send marketing emails only where the law of the country you live in allows it, which means that in some countries we send them only with your consent. Every marketing email states the sender, our postal address and how to stop receiving them. If you ask us to stop, we will comply free of charge within 10 business days. Emails about an order or account are not marketing emails. If we or a food truck provide order-progress notifications by text message, you receive them only if you have agreed, and you can stop receiving them at any time. / **If a problem occurs.** If a breach involving your personal information is likely to cause you serious harm, where the law requires it we will inform you and the supervisory authority as quickly as possible, or support the food truck you ordered from in doing so. / **Complaints.** Please tell us first at privacy@hatchgrab.com. We would be grateful for the chance to put the problem right. You can also complain to the personal data supervisory authority of the country you live in. In the UK this is the UK Information Commissioner's Office (Information Commissioner's Office, ICO), which you can contact at ico.org.uk or by phone on 0303 123 1113.
back.G: Our [Terms of Service](/terms) apply in every country where HatchGrab is used. Some countries have additional rules. This page sets those rules out country by country. / Where a section below applies to you, that section forms part of our Terms of Service. Where the content of that section differs from the Terms of Service, this page applies for that country. / If your country is not on the list, there are no additional rules, and the Terms of Service apply as written. Our [Privacy Policy](/privacy) is the same in every country.
